Second Stone: The Legend of the Hidden World

name: Second Stone
storyline:
Second Stone is set in a vast fantasy world where players can explore lush forests, deep caves and far-reaching deserts.

Step into the shoes of the young hero and set forth on a heroic journey where you will traverse through a dark parallel world to understand your purpose!
summary: Second Stone is a colorful Action RPG built around two fully playable parallel worlds. Play as Shiren, a young treasure hunter who can cross between the vibrant Light World and its sinister mirror, the Shrouded World. Master fast-paced combat and forge your path to power with elemental Manastones.
